s: Two friends sitting on a sofa, both laughing hard: a woman in her thirties with brown skin and long braids is doubled over, one of her hands flat on her own knee and the other lightly touching the shoulder of a man in his thirties with light olive skin who laughs too, eyes creased shut, shoulders shaking, both of his hands open on his lap. Each character has exactly two arms and two hands; every visible hand connects to a visible arm and has exactly five clearly separated fingers, with no extra fingers anywhere
